name: EQ
description: High-pass, low shelf, two peaking bands and a high shelf.

params.name: High-pass
params.description: Second-order high-pass cutoff; 0 turns it off.

params.name: Low shelf frequency
params.description: Corner of the low shelf.

params.name: Low shelf gain
params.description: Boost or cut below the low shelf corner.

params.name: Mid frequency
params.description: Centre of the peaking band.

params.name: Mid gain
params.description: Boost or cut of the peaking band.

params.name: Mid Q
params.description: Bandwidth of the peaking band; higher is narrower.

params.name: Presence frequency
params.description: Centre of the presence band.

params.name: Presence gain
params.description: Boost or cut of the presence band.

params.name: Presence Q
params.description: Bandwidth of the presence band.

params.name: High shelf frequency
params.description: Corner of the high shelf.

params.name: High shelf gain
params.description: Boost or cut above the high shelf corner.

name: Compressor
description: Stereo-linked feed-forward compressor with a soft knee.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: Level above which gain is reduced.

params.name: Ratio
params.description: Input dB above threshold per output dB.

params.name: Knee
params.description: Width of the soft knee around the threshold.

params.name: Attack
params.description: Time to react to a rise in level.

params.name: Release
params.description: Time to recover after the level falls.

params.name: Makeup gain
params.description: Gain applied after compression.

name: De-esser
description: Reduces the sibilance band when it exceeds the threshold.

params.name: Frequency
params.description: Lower edge of the sibilance band.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: Sibilance-band level above which it is reduced.

params.name: Range
params.description: Largest reduction of the sibilance band.

name: Reverb
description: Room simulation with parallel combs and series all-passes.

params.name: Room size
params.description: Larger rooms decay more slowly.

params.name: Damping
params.description: High-frequency absorption of the walls.

params.name: Pre-delay
params.description: Gap between the dry sound and the first reflections.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the reverberation.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Wet share of the output; 0 is dry.
